description: Ministry of Justice and Prison Reforms - Incorporation Order of Arthma Jothi Foundation Order under Section 114 of the Trust Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms exercising powers under the Trusts Ordinance to authorize the incorporation of trustees for "The Arthma Jothi Foundation." This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation (Trusts Ordinance Chapter 87), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on the legal framework for trust incorporation rather than government administration or personnel appointments.
